regime_notes: Fresh evidence published after the prior hourly mark resolves the missing RWA-utilization leg: Base tokenized stocks set a $100M daily DEX-volume record and reached $730.9M over 30 days. Aerodrome handled $557.1M (76%) and Uniswap v4 $139.3M. These are secondary-market swaps, not issuance/AUM.

Base overall DEX volume is $506.18M/24h versus $6.718B/7d, so the chain as a whole is not a broad fresh spot-DEX acceleration. The qualifying migration is narrower and financially substantive: tokenized-equity secondary trading.

Aerodrome currently shows $9.24M 7d holder revenue, $6.95M 7d earnings after incentives, and zero 24h incentives. The veAERO model distributes exchange revenue to locked AERO voters, giving the token direct but lock-dependent value capture.

Nansen-attributed reporting dated Sep. 8 says smart-money AERO balances rose from 4.26M to 7.26M tokens (+74%) over 30 days as new wallets entered. Funding-lineage and beneficial-owner independence were not available, so wallet quality is medium rather than high.
AERO is $0.5596, +2.4% over 7d and +38.3% over 30d. Its 24h token turnover is only ~$15.2M and down 77.4% from the prior day, so asset-level momentum is not strong enough to scale beyond a starter.

Structural gate passes with caveats. Official Aerodrome docs state weekly AERO emissions are around 10.9% annualized and expose governance/minter architecture; security docs list emergency council and multisigs. Automated/current sources find no honeypot, blacklist, transfer tax, or pause, and AERO has broad venue liquidity. Dilution/governance are material but not an arbitrary-mint or sellability hard failure based on current evidence.

No structural/value-capture break warrants a trim yet.
